visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand with trimmed fingernails holds a dark blue, glazed ceramic bowl with a wavy rim against a wooden table. Inside the bowl, the golden Chinese characters for 'Delicious' (美味) are clearly visible at the bottom. The lighting is warm and comes from an upper-left indoor source, creating soft shadows. (2) The hand rotates the bowl to provide a extreme close-up view of a small, white ceramic skull figure attached to the rim. The skull has dark brownish-gray stains or 'aged' residue in its eyes and deep crevices. The hand tilts the bowl, highlighting the texture of the glaze and the intentional stains. (3) The camera pulls back slightly to a medium shot as the bowl is placed flat on the wooden table. In the blurred background, other dark ceramic plates containing small green snacks (possibly mochi) are visible, establishing a dining environment. (4) A dark brown ceramic teapot enters the frame and pours a yellowish-green liquid (likely soup or tea) into the bowl. Steam rises from the hot liquid as it fills the basin, covering the gold text and reaching the chin of the ceramic skull figure, which appears to 'bathe' in the broth.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: One hand belonging to the narrator is the only human presence.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main character is only seen via their right hand, which appears to belong to an adult male based on hand size and skin texture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks Mandarin in a conversational, quirky tone, explaining that the dirt in the skull crevices is a 'bug' he intentionally left for 'flavor' over time. No BGM is present initially, only the dry vocal track and slight handling thuds. (2) The narrator begins humming a playful, cinematic melody with a rising pitch contour, which transitions into a hum-driven BGM track with light acoustic guitar strumming. The vocal delivery is high-energy and comedic. (3) A loud, broadband splash sound of liquid being poured into a vessel dominates the mix for several seconds. The hum-led BGM continues in the background, maintaining a lighthearted, major-mode atmosphere. (4) The narrator returns with a satisfied, lower-arousal tone, commenting on the quality of the 'soup' and concluding that the 'flavor' from the skull's crevices is essential. The music fades out gently.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a unique, custom-made ceramic bowl with a humorous and slightly macabre twist. The creator uses a 'flavor bug' joke to highlight the artistic details (the stains on the skull) before demonstrating the bowl in use with hot soup.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video blends hobbyist pottery with short-form comedic narration, using the visual of a 'dirty' ceramic skull to create a joke about accumulated flavor in food.
